tasks.short: She evaluates fitness and wellness programs for effectiveness.

steps.what: Evaluate fitness and wellness programs to determine their effectiveness.
inputs: what members said about the program
outputs: her call on whether the program worked

tasks.design: She still evaluates each fitness and wellness program and determines whether it was effective. Attendance she already sees, and comments members already gave, stay inputs to that call. No second write-up is added.
tasks.previous_blocker: Whether a program worked depends on who it was for and what happened in the room, which changes every month.
tasks.enabler_now: Shift plans and policy libraries in this group are other work. Determining whether a fitness or wellness program was effective stays manual.
tasks.still_hard: A quiet class that served the people it was for, and a full class that left members worse.
tasks.human_edge: She can tell a program failed the people it was meant for even when the room was full.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes. She still evaluates the programs and determines their effectiveness. She gains no right to drop or keep a program she has not judged.

reach.task: Say what happened in the class
reach.learn: Which detail changes her call on the program, and which does not

evidence.claim: Judging whether a fitness or wellness program worked is her call from attendance and what members said. A generated commentary on a finance report is a different task.

assumptions: She already looks at attendance and member comments while she makes this call. That look is the evaluation, not a separate entry this task removes.
She does not score instructors. This task is the program, not a staff rating.
Incremental upkeep is zero. No template, mapping, or list is added.
The evaluation keeps its full share. Nothing in this task is removed.
unknowns: Whether a site manager already decides which programs stop.
research_questions: Which programs does she still have to judge in the room with the instructor?

already_counted.description: She still evaluates the programs and determines their effectiveness.

incremental.description: No template, mapping, or list is kept. Upkeep hours are zero.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: She still evaluates each program and determines whether it worked. No step in this task is removed. The high stays at zero.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: She develops fitness classes and keeps the offerings diverse.

steps.what: Develop fitness or wellness classes such as yoga, aerobics, strength training, or aquatics.
ensuring a diversity of class offerings

tasks.design: She still develops the fitness or wellness class, including yoga, aerobics, strength training, and aquatics, on the floor with the people it is for. She still checks that the class offerings stay diverse. No timetable write is part of this task.
tasks.previous_blocker: A class has to fit the bodies in the room, the equipment on hand, and the level those members can do that week.
tasks.enabler_now: Shift planning in this group assigns times. It does not develop a yoga, aerobics, strength, or aquatics class. That development stays manual.
tasks.still_hard: A member who cannot do the movement, and a week when the pool or the studio is closed.
tasks.human_edge: She knows which movement is safe for the people who will be in that class.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes. She still develops the classes and still checks the diversity of offerings. She gains no right to publish a class she has not built.

reach.learn: Which part of the plan the instructor must not change, and which part can flex

evidence.claim: Developing a yoga, aerobics, strength, or aquatics class, and keeping the offerings diverse, is her design of the session. A shift plan only places a time.

assumptions: The class plan and the mix of offerings are the whole task. Posting a time on a timetable is a different task.
An instructor may teach the class. She still develops it.
Incremental upkeep is zero. No template, mapping, or list is added.
Both steps keep their full share. Nothing in this task is removed.
unknowns: Whether a lead instructor already develops some of these classes.
research_questions: Which movements does she still have to try in the room before the class is offered?

already_counted.description: She still develops the classes and still checks the diversity of offerings.

incremental.description: No template, mapping, or list is kept. Upkeep hours are zero.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: She still develops each class and still checks that the offerings stay diverse. No step in this task is removed. The high stays at zero.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: She demonstrates how members use the fitness equipment.

steps.what: Demonstrate proper operation of fitness equipment such as resistance machines.
inputs: the resistance machine in front of them
outputs: shown use of that resistance machine

steps.what: Demonstrate cardio machines, free weights, or fitness assessment devices.
inputs: the cardio machine, free weight, or assessment device in front of them

tasks.design: She still demonstrates proper operation in the room: resistance machines, cardio machines, free weights, and fitness assessment devices. The member is there. No recording stands in for that demonstration.
tasks.previous_blocker: The safe way to use a machine depends on the person in front of it and on how that machine is set that day.
tasks.enabler_now: Nothing in this group demonstrates a machine to a member. The demonstration stays on the floor, and this task is that demonstration.
tasks.still_hard: A member who grips the bar wrong, and a pin or a seat set for someone else.
tasks.human_edge: She sees the movement as it happens and stops it before someone is hurt.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes. She still demonstrates the equipment in person. She gains no right to tell a member a machine is safe without that demonstration.

reach.task: Watch a member repeat the movement
reach.learn: Which fault she stops at once, and which one can wait for the next set

evidence.claim: Demonstrating resistance machines, cardio machines, free weights, and fitness assessment devices is done in person with the member. A written note does not show the movement.

assumptions: The demonstration is the whole task. She does it on the floor with the member.
No recording or posted instruction is part of this statement.
Incremental upkeep is zero. No template, mapping, or list is added.
Both demonstrations keep their full share. Nothing in this task is removed.
unknowns: Whether instructors already demonstrate some machines before she is called over.
research_questions: Which machines does she still have to demonstrate herself?

already_counted.description: She still demonstrates the equipment in person.

incremental.description: No template, mapping, or list is kept. Upkeep hours are zero.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: She still demonstrates each machine in person. No step in this task is removed. The high stays at zero.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: She runs needs surveys and reads interest and satisfaction.

steps.what: Conduct needs assessments or surveys of wellness and fitness programs.
determine interest in or satisfaction with events or services
outputs: her reading of interest and satisfaction

tasks.design: She still conducts the needs assessment or survey in person, about wellness and fitness programs. She still determines interest in, and satisfaction with, the events and services from those answers. She does not mail a separate questionnaire in this task, so there is no send to gate.
tasks.previous_blocker: What members want depends on who is asked and on what they say about a program, an event, or a service, which a tick count does not settle.
tasks.enabler_now: Incident registers and shift plans in this group are other work. Asking members, and determining interest and satisfaction, stay with her.
tasks.still_hard: A member who wants an event the room cannot hold, and a polite answer that hides dissatisfaction.
tasks.human_edge: She hears which answer is about a real gap and which one is politeness.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes. She still conducts the assessment and still determines interest and satisfaction. She gains no right to add or drop an event from a tally she has not read.

reach.task: Hear which services members asked for
reach.learn: Which request belongs to the spa floor, and which one stays a fitness program

evidence.claim: Conducting a needs assessment or survey, and determining interest and satisfaction, is her asking members and reading what they say. A tally of closed ticks is not that reading.

assumptions: She asks members in person. This task does not include a mailed questionnaire, so no send is removed.
Questions are about programs, events, and services. She does not record a diagnosis.
Incremental upkeep is zero. No template, mapping, or list is added.
Both steps keep their full share. Nothing in this task is removed.
unknowns: Whether a front desk already collects the answers on some weeks.
research_questions: Which questions does she still have to ask herself?

already_counted.description: She still conducts the assessment and still determines interest and satisfaction.

incremental.description: No template, mapping, or list is kept. Upkeep hours are zero.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: She still asks members and still determines interest and satisfaction. No step in this task is removed. The high stays at zero.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Nothing in these tasks leaves her. Evaluating programs, developing classes, demonstrating equipment, and reading what members say stay her week. She gains no right to drop a program, publish a class, or call a machine safe without doing that work.
skills_to_grow: Judge a program from who it served, not from how full the room was.
Develop a class only after she can say which movement those members can do.
Demonstrate a machine until the member can use it without her hands on it.
Read an answer for the event or service it asks for, and leave politeness aside.
role.ambitious_version: She still evaluates every program, still develops the classes, still demonstrates the equipment, and still determines interest and satisfaction herself. She does not gain a right to let a timetable or a tally stand in for that work.
